_comment: Base-library canary (plan §2.2 S-F-3). Enumerates ONLY the upstream Microsoft.Extensions.AI AIContent [JsonDerivedType] $type discriminators that TemporalCommunity.Extensions.AI durable history actually serializes. Derived from base Contents/AIContent.cs and confirmed against our serialization (DurableAIDataConverterTests + ChatMessage/ChatResponse round-trips): TextContent('text') from ChatMessage text, FunctionCallContent('functionCall') + FunctionResultContent('functionResult') from tool turns, UsageContent('usage') from ChatResponse.Usage. The guard asserts the LIVE AIContent.PolymorphismOptions.DerivedTypes is a SUPERSET of this set, so our own additions never false-positive; only a base removal/rename of one of these discriminators fails the test. This is NOT the v0_3 snapshot (that tracks OUR DurableSessionEntry discriminators); this one tracks MICROSOFT's AIContent table.
